notes:
# OverCue 0.11.0

For CDJ-3000 firmware 3.22, supporting both hardware profiles.

- Uses one native Master Tempo engine for stems, improving toggle response, continuous volume fades, key shift and recovery after seeking.
- Improves cold-track stem page decoding and preparation while reducing extra audio processing.
- Adds a Stock/OverCue picker with a two-step confirmation and per-player loading/cache indicators when other linked players are using this player's media. Cache status describes the loaded track; it does not guarantee uninterrupted seeking during a source restart.
- Fixes the dim jog-display ring when starting with Light mode already saved.
- Adds a one-touch Full Mix reset beside the narrower Toggle/Volume selector, and orders the stem buttons Drums, Vocal, Harmonics. Full Mix restores all three levels without changing the selected mode.
- Makes playlist editing available when opening a playlist through Browse, as well as the physical PLAYLIST button.
- Shows Hot Cue letters and memory cue arrows on Browse waveform previews, with support for full and half waveforms and all Browse text sizes.
- Improves Light mode readability for the BPM and player boxes, restores the ZOOM/GRID indicators, and keeps Hot Cue letters black across waveform views.
- Fixes Light mode search text and stock Browse, Source, and Now Playing icons while preserving their original shapes and artwork colors.
- Keeps phrase names visible at the left edge of the scrolling waveform until the next phrase pushes them out.
- Fixes BPM edits failing on some rekordbox exports and supports larger export libraries without the previous file-size limit.
- Improves Gate Cue recovery when stale cue state could prevent PLAY from responding.
- Fixes Smart Cue so the first CUE press previews immediately after returning from a gated Hot Cue.
